body:
Now: 10 x the new level (level 40 = 400 coins), about 1 coin per XP. Tapping the school board earns 80-96 coins a minute.
Round 2 found my first idea (a fixed 50 a level) was worse: early levels need only 20-100 XP, so tapping at level 2-5 would pay up to 200 coins a minute.
New: a level-up pays 2 x the new level (level 10 = 20, level 40 = 80). Every 10th level (10, 20, 30, 40, 50) pays 100 extra as a milestone, with the star and toast as now.
Effect (estimate, tapping the school board): levels 1-10 about 37 coins a minute (once per skill), 10-20 about 23, after that about 15. A job pays about 22 a minute over a whole game day. One skill 1 to 50 = about 3,050 coins; all 9 = about 27,400 (now 114,660).
Saves: coins already earned stay.

comments.text: Second red team: fixed 50 a level would make early-level tapping pay more than now, so changed to 2 x level + milestones.

Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Level-ups pay 2 x level, plus 100 every 10th
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 1 (changed): level-ups pay 2 x level, plus 100 every 10th level
